caption: The video captures a calm pond in a hilly valley under a clear blue sky. A large leafless tree rises from the water at center, its trunk and bare branches mirrored on the surface. Dry golden reeds line the near bank, brown grassy slopes close from both sides, and a faint snow-dusted ridge sits far left. Throughout, the water remains mostly glassy but carries small moving ripples. These ripples continuously bend, wobble, and reshape the trunk, branch, sky, and hill reflections. The tree, foreground grass, hills, and background ridge hold the same positions relative to the edges. A thin ripple line on the right shifts slightly in place and intensity as the reflection deforms.
